visualReview.notes: All49 final views inspected:11 portable,11 shared-material/map placement and27 medium-fi comparisons. Square stone convent, narrow open court, inward-sloping red roof fields, massive Sturvolt, slender Tall Hermann, crenellated perimeter gallery and timber gate oriel retain the two inspected aerial pictures' main identity. Tower/gate arrangement agrees with the signed mapped building frame. Windows, roof junctions, stone color and individual carved details remain simplified.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All11 current shared-loader views inspected. Common limestone, ceramic tile, wood and painted-metal graphs provide reusable stone, red roof and oriel detail; glass uses local opaque PBR. Every graph loads once; unload releases geometry. Skyline bakes actual common linear means in one draw; detailed levels use five. Six GLBs contain zero embedded bitmap textures.

geographicReview.notes: Two inspected aerial pictures confirm the square stone convent, open court, inward-sloping red roofs, massive Sturvolt and slender Tall Hermann. Standard viewer PMTiles and cached building outline set location and signed tower/gate orientation. The flat site varies by less than1m at sampled corners; a reconstructed0.6m working rise and bounded foundation skirts clear that coarse surface. Anchor 22.479324007,58.246897902; heading -0.563076620916; standard PMTiles datum 9.787413303227948m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.

fidelityReview.notes: Accepted bounded medium-fi main-convent exterior from two actually inspected aerial pictures and standard viewer PMTiles. Sampled site corners vary by less than1m relative to the working datum;0.6m reconstructed rise and bounded foundations seat the body without a large pedestal. Northern Sturvolt, eastern Tall Hermann and northeast gate retain the map orientation. Individual openings, coping, roof junctions, floor levels, stone texture and gate details remain approximate. Surrounding star fort, moat, bridges, vegetation and navigable interiors are outside this model's scope. No survey accuracy, artificial hill or ground cutout is claimed. Physical-device timings and continuous-motion shimmer remain pending.

legacyFidelityScope.notes: Reviewed against docs-src/guide/medium-fi.md. The8215-triangle master uses five merged groups and four shared256² graphs; no unique textures. Fine tracery, diamond glass lattice, tiny joints, fixtures and full interiors are omitted. Roof geometry retains the mapped hole.
